tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. Long-form reading and every form lives here; body copy on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the registration panel and the payment-verification rows. Body copy on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Section bands, table stripes and disabled field fills. A barely-green neutral so it sits under the brand rather than beside it. Body copy on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Hero and order blocks that must read as brand ground in either theme. Text on it is `ink-inverse` at 12.1:1.

tokens.name: surface-ink
tokens.usage: Full-bleed navy blocks used to break a run of red. Text on it is `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `surface-page`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`. 17.3:1 in Light, 10.2:1 in Deep Emerald.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, field hints, metadata and timestamps. 7.4:1 in Light, 8.3:1 in Deep Emerald.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-brand`, `surface-ink`, `brand-700` and `brand-600` fills. 12.1:1 on `brand-700`, 7:1 on `brand-600`, 18:1 on `navy`.

tokens.name: ink-on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `gold` and `gold-deep` fills, as in the price badge. 9.7:1 on `gold`.

tokens.name: brand-900
tokens.usage: Darkest point of the brand gradient. Corner vignette on hero art, and the sunken surface in Deep Emerald.

tokens.name: brand-800
tokens.usage: Gradient mid-dark. Card ground in Deep Emerald, and the pressed state of `brand-700` fills.

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: The signature ground of the brand. Hero sections, the order block, e-mail headers. Text on it is `ink-inverse` at 12.1:1.

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and link colour on light surfaces, and the bright end of the brand gradient. 7:1 on `surface-page`, and white on it is 7.3:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Price badges and the standing Pre-order button. A fill only: at 1.4:1 on `surface-page` it must never be set as type in Light. 8.9:1 as a fill on `brand-700`. Text on it is `ink-on-gold`.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for `gold` fills, and the ring drawn around the price badge.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The wordmark's letterforms. Also the Light-theme focus ring and full-bleed contrast blocks. Text on it is `ink-inverse` at 18:1.

tokens.name: green-tile
tokens.usage: Retired. The wordmark no longer uses a tile; the speech bubble in the mark is `cream`.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The wordmark's plate. Put the logo on this whenever it sits on a red ground.

tokens.name: poster-crimson
tokens.usage: Editorial illustration only, for the campaign poster palette. Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: poster-paper
tokens.usage: Aged-paper ground in editorial illustration. Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: poster-brass
tokens.usage: Muted gold in editorial illustration, distinct from the brand `gold`. Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: poster-charcoal
tokens.usage: Label tags and rules in editorial illustration. Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative card hairlines and dividers. It carries no meaning and sits at 1.4:1 on purpose; anything a reader must see uses `border-strong`.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input outlines, table rules, and any border that carries meaning. 3.1:1 on `surface-page` in Light, 5.1:1 in Deep Emerald.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring. Draw it 3px with a 2px offset so the gap falls on the page surface: 18:1 in Light, 7.5:1 in Deep Emerald, including around `gold` fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Verified payments and confirmed seats. A lighter green than `brand-600` so a state never reads as a link. 5.2:1 in Light, 7.6:1 in Deep Emerald. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a `success` fill. 4.7:1 in Light.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Awaiting verification, and seat holds inside the last hours. 4.5:1 on `surface-page` in Light, 7.5:1 in Deep Emerald.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a `warning` fill. 4.7:1 in Light, 10.8:1 in Deep Emerald.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rejected payments, lapsed holds, destructive actions. Stays red on purpose now that the brand is green: an error must not look like a brand colour. 7.8:1 in Light.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` fill. 8.1:1 in Light.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Checklist sa bir subpoena duces tecum.
styles.usage: The single headline on a hero or pre-order block., always ending in a full stop. Drop to 40px below 640px wide. Sentence case: the weight carries the emphasis, not capitals.

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Section headings on a marketing page. Sentence case: the weight carries the emphasis, not capitals.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Sub-section headings and card titles on marketing pages. Sentence case: the weight carries the emphasis, not capitals.

styles.name: display-3
styles.usage: Step headings inside the registration and payment flow. Sentence case: the weight carries the emphasis, not capitals.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The peso figure inside a PriceBadge or a pricing row. Always written with the sign and a thousands separator. Sentence case: the weight carries the emphasis, not capitals.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Ipadala ang bayad sa GCash, pagkatapos i-upload ang resibo.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and payment instructions, where the reader must not misread a step.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A checklist guide for the taxpayer who receives a BIR Subpoena Duces Tecum.
styles.usage: Default body copy everywhere, `ink` on `surface-page` or `surface-raised`.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense rows: the verification queue, order summaries, tables.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footnotes and field hints, `ink-muted` on `surface-page` or `surface-raised`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.sample: 1 2 2 - P A G E   B O O K
styles.usage: The wide-tracked label above a headline. Uppercase, `gold` on red grounds and `ink-muted` on light ones.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button and pill label. Sentence case, not uppercase.

styles.name: price-note
styles.usage: The deadline strip under a price. Written the way the reader says it, not as a formal date.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a chip's icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a field label and its input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inline gap between adjacent buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, and the vertical gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between field groups inside one form step.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between steps in the registration flow.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips and the inner strip of a price badge.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and text inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the registration panel, and the wordmark plate.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large feature panels and the pre-order block.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The PRE-ORDER pill and every status chip.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: The price badge and avatar slots.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting state of a card on `surface-page`.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The registration panel and any card lifted off a section band.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The price badge, the book cover image, and modals.
